meta.name: code-health-sweep
meta.description: Assess technical debt and generate prioritized debt register with risk and quick wins. Use for stabilization planning and backlog grooming.

copy.tagline: 评估技术债务并生成优先级债务清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要系统性地识别和优先处理代码中的技术债务。
copy.tagline_en: Assess technical debt and generate a prioritized debt register
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs to systematically identify and prioritize technical debt in the codebase.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析代码仓库中的技术债务，生成一份按优先级排序的债务清单，包含风险等级和快速修复建议，并更新 DEBT.md 文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求评估技术债务、进行稳定化规划或积压任务梳理时触发。

say.text: 请扫描当前仓库的技术债务。
say.note: Claude 会分析代码并生成 DEBT.md。

say.text: 帮我梳理积压任务中的技术债务。
say.note: Claude 会按优先级排序并标注风险。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes the code repository for technical debt, generates a prioritized debt register with risk levels and quick wins, and updates DEBT.md.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to assess technical debt, perform stabilization planning, or groom the backlog.

say_en.text: Scan the current repository for technical debt.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and generate DEBT.md.

say_en.text: Help me groom technical debt in the backlog.
say_en.note: Claude will prioritize and flag risks.
